mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.7% indicates a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.7%, or the average forward return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic momentum and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPIAUCSL above 202.0 with a 12-month increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and increasing equity risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) at a quarterly pace above 3.0% indicates strong economic growth, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 combined with a rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a stagflationary risk, where supply shocks meet restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 100.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
